notes.title: Bug fixes! Patch 2.1
notes.notes:
Fixed the bug in level 49 when the merchant appears.
Fixed the bug with the achievement for unlocking all of the merchant's dialogues.
Fixed the bug where the Blessing of the Cross card would not disappear after being used.
Fixed the infinite points bug on the Power-Up screen.
Fixed the bug where the disc projectile obtained in level 4 would pass through walls.

notes.title: NEW UPDATE PATCH 2.0 – BE BLESSED!
notes.notes:
We are always listening to the community and working to make Red Tower an even better experience.
Thanks to the valuable feedback from our players, we have decided to implement several improvements suggested by you, along with some adjustments that were already in our plans.

Each update is designed to make the game more engaging, balanced, and fun. Stay tuned for the changes and keep sharing your suggestions—Red Tower evolves alongside the community! 🚀🔥🎮

🔥NEW FEATURES!🔥


🔥New card combination system implemented.
 You can now carry up to 5 blessing cards simultaneously, allowing you to discover new combinations and create unique builds!

🔥New 360º free aim added, compatible with mouse and gamepad.
 You can now enable or disable the free aim option. This allows players to aim and shoot freely without being restricted to 8 or 16 aiming directions.

🔥Option to disable the "camera shake" effect now available.
 A new option has been added to disable camera shake in the settings menu.

Option to disable free aim added.
 The new free aim system can be enabled or disabled via the settings menu.


🔨IMPROVEMENTS!🔨


New crosshair icons implemented.
 A new crosshair icon has been added to improve visibility during gameplay.

🔨Adjustment to the magic weapon obtained by defeating the boss Carnaroth.
 The visual effects of the magic weapon obtained from Carnaroth have been updated to better reflect its power.

🔨Audio system adjustments.
 Fixed an issue where audio settings were not being properly applied from the options menu.

Shader compilation system adjustments.
 Fixed an issue where shaders appeared distorted or displayed artifacts on some AMD graphics cards.

Translation adjustments for "Experimental" languages.
 Fixed incorrect translations in certain languages that did not match the original text.


Once again, we at Dream4Team sincerely thank all players for their feedback. If you find any errors in your native language, please report them to us, and we will correct them as quickly as possible!
